description: src/session.rs:58-65. The rustdoc on ChatCapability.extra references 'spec commit 80d5e11' for the historical record of the 2026-05-11 capability-field-removal. Commit hashes age out as repos rebase, get rewritten, or move forge. AGENTS.md 'Backend caps and limits' is the right place for the historical record (it already carries 'bead bd:JMAP-kt5k' as the durable workspace pointer). Inline rustdoc should describe the current state ('no longer in the spec, enforced via overQuota') without the commit hash. Same applies to the parallel ChatPushCapability comment if any historical context is added there later.
title: ChatCapability extra rustdoc carries spec commit hash that will age out
